stories.title: Ok della Camera alla fiducia sui primi due articoli della legge elettorale

en.title: Chamber approves confidence vote on first two articles of electoral law
en.summary: Italy's Chamber of Deputies approved a confidence vote on the initial two articles of an electoral law bill that includes Senate amendments and increased signature requirements.

stories.title: Il Nobel per la Fisica a Francis Hazen: "Le mie scoperte? Una pura fortuna"

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to Francis Halzen: "My discoveries? Pure luck"
en.summary: Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for contributions to the IceCube Observatory and discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos. He expressed surprise rather than pride in his achievements.

stories.title: Calcio, la giunta del Coni approva Malagò quale commissario della Figc

en.title: Football: CONI board approves Malagò as commissioner of Italian Football Federation
en.summary: The Italian Olympic Committee board appointed Malagò as commissioner of the Italian Football Federation, with Malagò stating he accepts the role with a commitment to service.

stories.title: Nobel per la Fisica a Francis Halzen per aver catturato i neutrini con un osservatorio speciale

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to Francis Halzen for capturing neutrinos with special observatory
en.summary: Belgian-born U.S. scientist Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in Physics for lifelong research on elusive elementary particles with minimal mass that rarely interact with matter.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner costretto allo stop: “Devo pensare alla mia carriera a lungo termine”

en.title: Jannik Sinner forced to stop: "I must think about my career long term"
en.summary: Italian tennis star Jannik Sinner is taking a break until the end of the year to treat a persistent knee problem that has affected him for several months.

stories.title: Crans-Montana, Jessica Moretti chiede un’indennità per l’infortunio nell’incendio al Constellation

en.title: Crans-Montana, Jessica Moretti seeks compensation for injury in Constellation fire
en.summary: The owner of a venue is seeking compensation under Swiss law for health damages and lost income resulting from an injury sustained in a fire.

stories.title: Jessica Moretti chiede l'indennità per l'infortunio nell'incendio di Crans-Montana

en.title: Jessica Moretti seeks compensation for injury in Crans-Montana fire
en.summary: Swiss law provides for compensation in this case. Insurance has opened proceedings regarding health damages. The woman may receive a daily allowance for lost income caused by the injury.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, ok alle fiducie sui primi due articoli. L’opposizione protesta: è incostituzionale

en.title: Electoral law, confidence votes pass on first two articles. Opposition protests: unconstitutional
en.summary: The Chamber of Deputies approved confidence motions on the initial articles of an electoral law bill. Final approval by secret ballot is scheduled for Thursday, with opposition parties and some government lawmakers raising objections about gender representation impacts.

stories.title: Malagò è commissario della Figc: “Vicenda triste e imbarazzante”. Buonfiglio: “Squallidi attacchi a mia famiglia”

en.title: Malagò becomes FIGC commissioner: "A sad and embarrassing matter". Buonfiglio: "Squalid attacks on my family"
en.summary: Malagò was appointed commissioner of the Italian Football Federation following a ten-minute meeting, with the decision confirmed by the National Council, which also approved the commissioning of the Sports Federation. Legal challenges have been filed against the decision.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, sì alla fiducia sui primi due articoli. Le opposizioni: “È incostituzionale”

en.title: Electoral law, confidence vote passes on first two articles. Opposition: "It is unconstitutional"
en.summary: The government secured a confidence vote on the first two articles of an electoral law proposal. Opposition parties have challenged the law as unconstitutional, with further votes scheduled.

stories.title: Chi è Francis Halzen, vincitore del Nobel per la Fisica 2026

en.title: Who is Francis Halzen, winner of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
en.summary: Halzen designed an observatory for detecting neutrinos at the South Pole and also serves on the Scientific Council of the Gran Sasso Science Institute in Italy.

stories.title: Nobel per la Fisica 2026 al belga Francis Halzen per la scoperta dei neutrini cosmici

en.title: Belgian Francis Halzen awarded 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for cosmic neutrino discovery
en.summary: Physicist Francis Halzen from Belgium received the Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering cosmic neutrinos, following last year's award for quantum tunneling research.

stories.title: Il Salone di Genova si chiude con oltre 138mila visitatori

en.title: Genoa Boat Show closes with over 138,000 visitors
en.summary: The 66th edition of the Genoa International Boat Show concluded with visitor numbers exceeding 138,000, representing an 11.2 percent increase compared to the previous year's event.

stories.title: Stellantis, cresce la produzione in Italia ma Mirafiori frena e Cassino è in negativo

en.title: Stellantis, production grows in Italy but Mirafiori slows and Cassino is negative
en.summary: Stellantis production in Italy increased 28.3% in the third quarter compared to 2025, with automobile production up 36.7%. Forecasts for 2026 project 450,000 vehicles, though some plants including Mirafiori and Cassino are experiencing declines.

stories.title: Nucleare, Mimit e Mase aprono la corsa delle imprese all’Ipcei: proposte entro il 3 dicembre

en.title: Nuclear, Mimit and Mase open the race for companies in the Ipcei: proposals by December 3
en.summary: The Italian government has launched an industrial initiative for nuclear energy development, inviting company proposals by December 3, following the Senate's approval of nuclear legislation.

stories.title: Firenze, la sinergia spinge i musei, +22% di incassi per il nuovo Gamb

en.title: Florence, synergy boosts museums, +22% revenue for new Gamb
en.summary: The integrated Florence museum system combining the Accademia Gallery and Bargello Museums has exceeded revenue expectations with a 22% increase.

stories.title: Finish Group rileva Termoacustica Pugliese e punta a 20 milioni di ricavi nel 2026

en.title: Finish Group acquires Termoacustica Pugliese and targets 20 million euros in revenue by 2026
en.summary: Finish Group, a construction materials manufacturer based in Puglia since 1956, has acquired Termoacustica Pugliese to strengthen its position in lightweight building systems.
